asset: Workyard shoreline net, buoy crate, and rope cluster

north.notes: Buoys bear on the crate interior; rack feet and braces reach the floor.

south.notes: Crate slats contain each buoy and the rope coil remains clearly separated.

east.notes: No buoy escapes the crate sides; net stand, crate, and rope do not intersect.

west.notes: Varied buoy lean reads naturally and all visible supports meet the floor.
